boundaries.rationale: Public entry points and domain-specific tests keep dependency direction explicit; boundary script verifies directions.
boundaries.countercheck: Consumer-domain verification and full boundary checks pass; settings/inference documentation omissions corrected.

flow.rationale: State transitions, one writer, receipts/epochs and atomic domain/queue settlement are traced and cancellation/restart tested.
flow.countercheck: Reproduced and fixed two adoption/acceptance races; stale owner and rollback tests preserve atomicity.

fit.rationale: Single-process loopback and one SQLite writer match documented macOS prototype scope. Real provider/scale acceptance remains separate.

contracts.rationale: Valid and invalid schema/process/HTTP contracts checked; CLI UUID and error codes corrected.
contracts.countercheck: Malformed URL, missing/invalid UUID, offline process and permission rejection exercised.

edge_cases.rationale: History budget, bounded streams, duplicate requests, progress ranges and settings key lifecycle cover important edge invariants.
edge_cases.countercheck: Unanswered prior turn, deleted/replaced keys, min/max progress and existing SSE-prefix cases checked.

concurrency.rationale: Ordering, cancellation, writer transactions, resource slots and late-result fences tested across backend and browser audio.
concurrency.countercheck: Writer-window voice negative control plus pending resume, owner loss and cancelled inference regressions pass.

access.rationale: Loopback, bearer and Origin controls traced; epoch revocation and stale parent receipts protect provider/adoption boundary in inspected scope.

input_secrets.rationale: Schema validation, bounded audio/stream inputs, backend-only encrypted credentials and pruning of obsolete ciphertext verified; privileges limited to configured providers/local store.

abuse.rationale: Body/response/SSE limits, queue capacity, finite retry and concurrency bounds control inspected authenticated loopback abuse paths.

failure.rationale: Timeout/errors/cancellation preserve run/job state; partial stream cannot append fallback; offline CLI becomes explicit.
failure.countercheck: Adoption rejection, pending audio start, expired connection, timeout late result and interrupted streams exercised.

recovery.rationale: Persisted pending queue work, atomic idempotency and crash/restart behavior verified with process tests; LARM recovery bounded to explicit conditions.
recovery.countercheck: Killed-process cases before claim/during handler and forbidden replay after SSE publication pass; live provider semantics excluded.

resilience.rationale: Bounded response/queue/voice-ahead resources and finite provider fallback handle modeled dependency failure; heartbeat listener cleanup prevents accumulation.

clarity.rationale: Principal behavior traced through named public contracts and owned repositories; docs now match settings/inference entry points.

change.rationale: Eleven representative fixes remain in owning domains/common interfaces with targeted verification and useful regressions.
change.countercheck: Queue settle type change verified in dialogue/inference/voice consumers and full suite; shared UI implicit globals removed.

debt.unknown_reason: Sustained maintenance cost/history not investigated sufficiently.

duplication.unknown_reason: All repeated cross-project contracts were not exhaustively compared.

reuse.rationale: Web and CLI share transport; common UI contracts are exercised without hidden globals and built into Web.

abstraction.rationale: Shared transport, typed ports/settle outcomes and UI primitives have concrete consumers and keep DB/credentials in backend.

risk_coverage.rationale: Primary API/voice/queue/state/recovery/security cases plus fixture browser tests and shared component suite exercised.
risk_coverage.countercheck: Reproduced eleven root-cause groups; removed artificial globals and added process and race assertions; real audio remains untested.

quality.rationale: Red/green regressions check provider inputs, no-ASR-after-stop, stored state, listener counts, exit codes and ARIA values.
quality.countercheck: Negative-control removal of voice writer guard fails; fixed initial Bun assertion scheduling problem; UI global mocks no longer hide exceptions.

automation.rationale: Documented per-domain and full commands enforce format/lint/type/boundary/tests/build/browser checks with source mutation guard. Actual CI/release history not established.
